tools.name: search_activities
tools.description: Search OiAir public activities using its current search API, ranking and filters. Age is inclusive; weekdays use Sunday=0 through Saturday=6, and any selected day may match. Age, day and time must match the same published group. Keep unresolved constraints and unknown availability; results do not co

tools.name: get_organization
tools.description: Read the current public organization profile and its address-scoped published groups, prices and source timestamps. This exposes published facts only and does not provide staff, parent or participant data.

tools.name: list_offerings
tools.description: List all current published groups belonging to one public organization at its current address. Each group retains its exact publication ID, version, schedule, prices and confirmation timestamps; an empty list does not authorize substituting another group.

tools.name: get_offering
tools.description: Read one exact, current published group by publication ID. Optionally require its expected version. Withdrawn, expired, changed-address or stale-version groups fail rather than falling back to another group. Published availability remains unknown.

tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description: Prepare a canonical PT-BR OiAir form link for one exact organization, publication and expected version. Trial requires that the selected group offers a trial. Opening the link and submitting a request are separate actions; this tool neither submits a request nor reserves or confirms a place.
